1
00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:03.440
Aisha helps an applicant considering variable life insurance.

2
00:00:04.160 --> 00:00:08.820
The file involves state insurance licensing, possible consumer reports,

3
00:00:09.300 --> 00:00:12.860
securities requirements and company procedures.

4
00:00:13.700 --> 00:00:16.400
No single organization does every job.

5
00:00:17.240 --> 00:00:20.860
Maryland's Insurance Administration regulates insurance in the state.

6
00:00:21.640 --> 00:00:26.360
Federal law can separately govern consumer reports, specified fraud and

7
00:00:26.360 --> 00:00:31.360
securities activities. An insurer's procedure can add practical steps,

8
00:00:32.180 --> 00:00:33.720
but it cannot replace the law.

9
00:00:34.600 --> 00:00:39.240
Begin each question by identifying the transaction and the organization or

10
00:00:39.240 --> 00:00:42.420
rule that actually has responsibility for it.

11
00:00:43.026 --> 00:00:47.146
The Fair Credit Reporting Act governs consumer reports used for purposes

12
00:00:47.146 --> 00:00:49.506
such as insurance underwriting.

13
00:00:50.126 --> 00:00:52.366
A report must have a permitted purpose.

14
00:00:53.186 --> 00:00:56.366
If an insurer takes an adverse action based in whole or

15
00:00:56.366 --> 00:01:01.646
part on a consumer report, required notice identifies the reporting agency,

16
00:01:01.646 --> 00:01:06.266
explains that the agency did not make the decision, and describes

17
00:01:06.266 --> 00:01:08.806
dispute and free-report rights.

18
00:01:08.806 --> 00:01:14.146
Adverse action can include denial or less favorable terms,

19
00:01:15.106 --> 00:01:16.386
not just a total rejection.

20
00:01:17.486 --> 00:01:23.046
Investigative reports based on personal interviews have additional disclosure

21
00:01:23.046 --> 00:01:28.012
requirements. Federal law addresses fraud and false statements in insurance

22
00:01:28.012 --> 00:01:32.892
affecting interstate commerce. A person with a felony involving dishonesty or

23
00:01:32.892 --> 00:01:36.332
breach of trust, or a conviction for a specified federal insurance

24
00:01:36.332 --> 00:01:40.952
offense, may be prohibited from willfully engaging in that business without

25
00:01:40.952 --> 00:01:43.972
written consent from the appropriate insurance regulator.

26
00:01:44.372 --> 00:01:47.632
A producer license alone is not a substitute for required federal

27
00:01:47.632 --> 00:01:51.752
consent. Nor does this mean every conviction has exactly the same

28
00:01:51.752 --> 00:01:54.959
consequence. State licensing standards and

29
00:01:54.959 --> 00:01:57.459
federal restrictions must both be checked.

30
00:01:58.317 --> 00:02:01.917
Variable life and variable annuities combine insurance features with

31
00:02:01.917 --> 00:02:06.357
investment exposure. State insurance authority remains necessary, and

32
00:02:06.357 --> 00:02:09.317
securities registration and sales requirements also apply.

33
00:02:09.797 --> 00:02:12.397
The Securities and Exchange Commission oversees federal securities

34
00:02:12.397 --> 00:02:16.517
regulation, while FINRA regulates its member broker-dealers and associated

35
00:02:16.517 --> 00:02:21.657
persons. A prospectus explains investment risks, fees and other contract

36
00:02:21.657 --> 00:02:26.157
features. Registration is not a government endorsement or a guarantee of

37
00:02:26.157 --> 00:02:30.437
returns. A life-only license does not by itself grant every permission

38
00:02:30.437 --> 00:02:32.197
needed to sell variable products.

39
00:02:32.823 --> 00:02:36.783
The National Association of Insurance Commissioners supports state insurance

40
00:02:36.783 --> 00:02:40.103
regulators with coordination, data and model standards.

41
00:02:41.043 --> 00:02:45.643
A model law does not automatically become Maryland law simply because

42
00:02:45.643 --> 00:02:47.243
the association adopts it.

43
00:02:47.943 --> 00:02:52.283
The Interstate Insurance Product Regulation Commission administers the

44
00:02:52.283 --> 00:02:57.543
Insurance Compact. It provides a coordinated filing and review process

45
00:02:57.543 --> 00:03:01.883
for covered products using uniform standards adopted under the compact.

46
00:03:02.473 --> 00:03:06.543
That product-review role is different from issuing an individual producer

47
00:03:06.543 --> 00:03:10.123
license or resolving every consumer complaint.

48
00:03:10.683 --> 00:03:14.683
Keep product standards separate from a producer's personal authority.

49
00:03:15.609 --> 00:03:20.109
The National Council of Insurance Legislators is commonly called N-coil.

50
00:03:20.949 --> 00:03:25.249
This organization brings state legislators together on insurance issues and

51
00:03:25.249 --> 00:03:30.169
develops model legislation. Industry and producer associations provide

52
00:03:30.169 --> 00:03:34.429
education, representation and professional resources.

53
00:03:35.489 --> 00:03:39.149
They do not replace the regulator or issue a Maryland producer

54
00:03:39.149 --> 00:03:44.069
license. Route a licensing question to the Insurance Administration, a

55
00:03:44.069 --> 00:03:49.169
compact product-standard question to the Compact, and

56
00:03:49.169 --> 00:03:52.929
a model-law discussion to the relevant organization.

57
00:03:54.069 --> 00:03:57.489
On the exam, a familiar acronym is not enough.

58
00:03:58.309 --> 00:04:03.529
Match the organization's actual function
to the facts before selecting an answer.

1
00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:03.980
Elena joins an insurance agency and is eager to help clients.

2
00:00:04.940 --> 00:00:08.660
The agency's license does not automatically authorize her to sell insurance

3
00:00:08.660 --> 00:00:13.900
personally. Maryland generally requires the appropriate producer license

4
00:00:13.900 --> 00:00:18.240
before a person sells, solicits or negotiates insurance.

5
00:00:19.240 --> 00:00:21.880
The license identifies permitted lines of authority.

6
00:00:22.880 --> 00:00:27.580
Acting for an insurer also raises appointment requirements, which we examine

7
00:00:27.580 --> 00:00:33.320
separately. Licensing protects consumers by setting qualifications and

8
00:00:33.320 --> 00:00:38.500
accountability. Passing a course or an exam is an important step,

9
00:00:38.920 --> 00:00:41.800
but neither is itself permission to start selling.

10
00:00:42.402 --> 00:00:46.442
A regular resident individual applicant for a Maryland life producer license

11
00:00:46.442 --> 00:00:50.602
must be at least eighteen, have the required character and trustworthiness,

12
00:00:51.422 --> 00:00:55.362
satisfy the applicable examination requirement, submit a complete truthful

13
00:00:55.362 --> 00:00:57.622
application and pay the required fee.

14
00:00:58.342 --> 00:01:00.022
Additional documentation may be requested.

15
00:01:00.682 --> 00:01:04.902
Maryland removed its mandatory prelicensing education requirement effective

16
00:01:04.902 --> 00:01:06.082
October first, twenty twenty-four.

17
00:01:07.802 --> 00:01:11.422
That did not remove the licensing exam or continuing education for

18
00:01:11.422 --> 00:01:13.742
renewal. Preparation still matters.

19
00:01:14.282 --> 00:01:18.002
If an applicant fails an exam, Maryland law requires at least

20
00:01:18.002 --> 00:01:20.582
four days before taking another examination.

21
00:01:21.492 --> 00:01:26.152
A producer's home state is connected to the person's principal residence

22
00:01:26.152 --> 00:01:29.072
or business and resident license.

23
00:01:30.072 --> 00:01:35.392
A nonresident Maryland applicant ordinarily relies on a current resident

24
00:01:35.392 --> 00:01:40.512
license in good standing, the required application and fee, and

25
00:01:40.512 --> 00:01:45.672
reciprocity. A home-state license is not a nationwide permission

26
00:01:45.672 --> 00:01:51.632
slip. A business entity must obtain its own required authority and

27
00:01:51.632 --> 00:01:55.552
designate a licensed producer as its principal contact with the

28
00:01:55.552 --> 00:02:01.072
Administration. That contact maintains required information and

29
00:02:01.072 --> 00:02:06.692
helps with investigations. An agency cannot avoid these obligations simply

30
00:02:06.692 --> 00:02:09.992
by calling everyone an independent contractor.

31
00:02:10.806 --> 00:02:15.946
Maryland separately defines insurance advisers, including compensated policy

32
00:02:15.946 --> 00:02:20.706
analysis and certain public representations of advisory services.

33
00:02:20.946 --> 00:02:25.926
Statutory exceptions matter: a licensed producer acting as a producer for

34
00:02:25.926 --> 00:02:29.586
a client is among the exceptions to the adviser subtitle.

35
00:02:30.666 --> 00:02:35.106
Do not assume every ordinary product explanation requires a second license.

36
00:02:35.826 --> 00:02:39.846
Equally, do not assume a marketing title creates authority.

37
00:02:40.746 --> 00:02:45.306
Now consider viatical settlements, in which an existing life policy is

38
00:02:45.306 --> 00:02:50.586
sold. Settlement providers and brokers have separate registration rules.

39
00:02:51.726 --> 00:02:56.766
A provider registers before acting; a broker must register

40
00:02:56.766 --> 00:03:00.386
no later than thirty days after negotiating a settlement for a

41
00:03:01.134 --> 00:03:05.584
viator. An employee who performs only qualifying clerical or administrative

42
00:03:05.584 --> 00:03:10.284
tasks and receives no policy commissions may fit a licensing exception.

43
00:03:11.324 --> 00:03:15.404
Changing that person's job to soliciting applicants changes the analysis.

44
00:03:16.471 --> 00:03:20.411
Another exception can apply to an employer administering its own employee

45
00:03:20.411 --> 00:03:22.831
benefits without insurer compensation.

46
00:03:23.591 --> 00:03:28.571
These are conditional exceptions, not blanket permission for unlicensed

47
00:03:28.571 --> 00:03:33.591
selling. Consider Elena's assistant: scheduling

48
00:03:33.591 --> 00:03:36.811
an appointment is different from persuading the client to choose a

49
00:03:36.811 --> 00:03:42.211
particular life policy. Review both the actual conduct and the compensation,

50
00:03:42.211 --> 00:03:44.751
rather than relying on a job title.

51
00:03:45.313 --> 00:03:50.313
In this scenario, an agency owner dies and an eligible relative

52
00:03:50.313 --> 00:03:52.993
needs to help preserve the business.

53
00:03:53.813 --> 00:03:59.393
Maryland may issue a temporary producer license without the usual examination

54
00:03:59.393 --> 00:04:04.493
to specified otherwise-qualified relatives, representatives or

55
00:04:04.493 --> 00:04:08.773
employees connected to a deceased or disabled producer.

56
00:04:09.473 --> 00:04:12.133
It is not automatic inheritance of a license.

57
00:04:12.133 --> 00:04:17.253
The person applies, pays the fee and obtains the temporary

58
00:04:17.253 --> 00:04:20.833
license and any required appointment before acting.

59
00:04:21.893 --> 00:04:25.773
The Commissioner must issue or refuse it in writing within thirty

60
00:04:25.773 --> 00:04:27.753
days of receiving the application.

61
00:04:27.753 --> 00:04:33.173
This Maryland temporary license expires fifteen months after

62
00:04:33.173 --> 00:04:34.233
its effective date.

It is also different from taking an accelerated benefit under the

00:00:41.757 --> 00:00:46.937
Evaluate the actual transaction rather than relying only on its marketing

11
00:00:46.937 --> 00:00:52.115
name. The viator is the owner or certificate holder seeking or

00:00:52.115 --> 00:00:56.595

00:00:56.595 --> 00:01:01.655

Maryland deems the broker to represent only the viator and to

00:01:05.715 --> 00:01:10.055

00:01:10.055 --> 00:01:14.375

00:01:14.955 --> 00:01:19.595
A later purchaser or financing entity may acquire an interest from

00:01:19.595 --> 00:01:21.735

00:01:26.435 --> 00:01:28.335

00:01:28.989 --> 00:01:34.149
In Maryland's settlement statute, terminally ill means an illness

22
00:01:34.149 --> 00:01:38.269
or sickness reasonably expected to result in death within twenty-four months

23
00:01:38.269 --> 00:01:43.689
or less. Chronically ill includes inability to perform at

24
00:01:43.689 --> 00:01:48.569
least two activities of daily living, substantial supervision needed because

25
00:01:48.569 --> 00:01:52.649
of severe cognitive impairment, or the stated similar disability.

26
00:01:52.649 --> 00:01:57.629
Activities of daily living include bathing, continence,

27
00:01:58.389 --> 00:02:02.929
dressing, eating, toileting and transferring.

28
00:02:04.089 --> 00:02:08.609
These are statutory definitions for this context, not permission for an

29
00:02:08.609 --> 00:02:10.289

30
00:02:11.109 --> 00:02:15.789
They can affect specified transaction rules and must be supported through

31

Daniel should understand alternatives, possible taxes, creditor exposure,

34

00:02:34.023 --> 00:02:38.583

00:02:38.583 --> 00:02:43.663

37
00:02:44.403 --> 00:02:49.663
Offers and related responses must reach the viator within seventy-two hours

38
00:02:49.663 --> 00:02:53.003

These are different clocks.

40
00:02:53.763 --> 00:02:58.943
Medical and personal information also require the stated disclosure and

41
00:02:58.943 --> 00:03:04.323

42

Maryland gives him fifteen calendar days after receipt to rescind, subject

44
00:03:12.453 --> 00:03:16.033
to returning the required proceeds, premiums and loan interest.

45
00:03:16.653 --> 00:03:20.273
If the insured dies during that period, the contract is deemed

46
00:03:20.273 --> 00:03:22.833
rescinded under the stated repayment conditions.

47
00:03:23.653 --> 00:03:27.353
The provider must send funds within three business days after receiving

48
00:03:27.353 --> 00:03:31.353
the specified acknowledgment of the policy transfer and beneficiary

49
00:03:31.353 --> 00:03:36.033
designation. A separate rule generally restricts a settlement within two

50
00:03:36.033 --> 00:03:40.733

51
00:03:40.733 --> 00:03:44.973
or independent evidence. Do not substitute another state's deadlines.

52
00:03:45.759 --> 00:03:50.199
Someone offers to alter Daniel's medical records to raise the settlement

53
00:03:50.199 --> 00:03:55.479

54
00:03:55.479 --> 00:04:00.639

55
00:04:00.639 --> 00:04:03.019

56
00:04:03.999 --> 00:04:08.459
Correct an honest error through the proper process; never invent a

57
00:04:08.459 --> 00:04:13.019

58
00:04:13.689 --> 00:04:17.859
The broker should protect the viator's interests and disclose the required

59
00:04:17.859 --> 00:04:22.339
information. Before proceeding, compare the alternatives,

60
00:04:23.099 --> 00:04:28.139
confirm authority and registration, review the offered value and

61
00:04:28.139 --> 00:04:32.879
transferred rights, and make sure Daniel understands what his original

62
00:04:32.879 --> 00:04:34.699
beneficiaries may lose.
